'''Republic Intelligence''', known also as '''Military Intelligence''' during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], was the primary external intelligence service of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Republic Intelligence was tasked with gathering, processing, and analyzing security information from around [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Republic Intelligence was separate from its domestic counterpart under the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]].

==Overview==
{{Quote|Every world within the Republic had an Intelligence team, even if that team consisted of a pair of agents who spent most of their time watching broadcast entertainments.|[[Joram Kithe]]|<ref name="League of Spies">{{InsiderCite|73|The League of Spies}}</ref>}}
As part of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], Republic Intelligence was separate from the Republic's three major civilian intelligence agencies including the [[Republic Security Organization]], the [[Interstellar Consortium on Technology]], and the [[Special Acquisitions Branch]] of the [[Library of the Republic]].<ref name="compswe" /> Among its sub-divisions was the [[Analysis Bureau (Republic Intelligence)|Analysis Bureau of Republic Intelligence]]. The [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]] was a separate civilian agency which is with the Senate.<ref name="HNN 15:2:22">{{InsiderCite|74|Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 15:2:22}}</ref>

It was led by the [[Director of Republic Intelligence]]. [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] was the director during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and also served as [[Director of the Senate Bureau of Intelligence|Director]] of the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]].<ref name="Shadowtrooper" />

==History==
===Mandalorian Wars===
During the [[Jedi Civil War]]. [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] became a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and forged a new [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] which consisted of many of his own followers included soldiers that had originally served the Republic. Republic Intelligence reports indicated evidence that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] had suffered even greater casualties after the war, when the [[First Jedi Purge]] was being perpetrated, but the information remained classified until some time after the [[Conclave at Katarr]], so the dissolution of the Order became one of the greatest mysteries of that time.<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

===Great War and Cold War===
{{Quote|Now we're what -- the thirtieth, fortieth attempt at a Republic espionage agency?''"<br />"''Depends whose conspiracy theories you believe.|RSIS Director and [[Theron Shan]]|<ref name="TORTLS1" />}}
{{Main|Republic Strategic Information Service}}
In the years leading up the the [[Great Galactic War]], the Republic had made several attempts to operate a viable intelligence organization with peace time duties though they had had little success. With the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the start of the Great War, the Republic saw the need for a capable espionage agency. With most of the military intelligence dismantled, the Republic turned to the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|Strategic Information Service]] of the [[Senate Library]]. The SIS was reorganized and moved from its simple duties of decryption and monitoring duties under the Senate Library and transferred into a full fledged intelligence and espionage agency. Though technically a part of the military intelligence, it became the de facto central intelligence service of the Republic and served in this capacity throughout the Great War. It continued to gather intelligence on its [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|intelligence counterpart]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] standoff between the Sith Empire and the Republic.<ref name="TORTLS1" /> At some point after the Cold War ended, the Republic dissolved the SIS and Republic Intelligence was reestablished later on along with the [[Senate Bureau of Intelligence/Legends|Senate Bureau of Intelligence]].<ref name="Shadowtrooper" />

===Post&ndash;Ruusan Reformation===
Republic Intelligence remained active through [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when it was involved in watching the activities of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Certain intelligence officers expressed the concern that the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] in charge of the Federation were taking control of outlying systems through deceitful or militaristic tactics. Once this was done, the Trade Federation would form exclusive contracts with the newly conquered world and enforce them with further threats of military action. In addition, the Federation had been keeping the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] under observation, though knew little of the workings of their underwater cities or even the size of their [[High Board Room/Legends|Rep Council]]. In addition, intelligence agents reported pirate gangs on Naboo that dealt in the trade of stolen [[Shaak/Legends|Shaak]].<ref name="SoN">''[[Secrets of Naboo]]''</ref> In the time following the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Republic Intelligence was responsible for the examination of the [[Star Courier/Legends|Star Courier]] [[Scimitar/Legends|vessel]] that belonged to the slain [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord known as [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. However, the intelligence agents made a mistake during the entry into the ship which led to the weapons, flight and communication systems on the ship self destructing. The remains of the damaged ship were left in a secret hangar on [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] where it remained for many years.<ref name="LE" />

===The Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Republic Intelligence has tracked several heavily-cloaked commando droid shuttles to this area. Whatever they're up to, they don't want anyone ''knowing about it''.|[[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]]|<ref name="Dug Out">{{TCWComicCite|6.19|Dug Out}}</ref>}}
At the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the organization was largely a covert force which had no use for uniforms.<ref name="LSatSoM" /> It played a crucial role during the conflict where it operated against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Besany Wennen]] of the [[Republic Treasury Audit Division]] was informed by a [[Gurlanin]] that Republic Intelligence was monitoring her movements and kept surveillance on her.<ref name="Truecolors" /> Following the [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']]{{'s}} [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|destruction]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Lock (clone trooper)|Lock]] led a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Breakout Squad|team]] to search through the cruiser's debris. They found evidence that the warship had been constructed by the [[Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps/Legends|Free Dac Volunteers Engineering Corps]] at [[Pammant/Legends|Pammant]], confirming beliefs held by Republic Intelligence.<ref name="Breakout Squad">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 1: Breakout Squad]]''</ref> Republic Intelligence conducted data-interception efforts to prevent holos of [[Alto Stratus]] from spreading. Despite this, bootleg holos of the [[Jabiimi]] Separatist leader managed to proliferate throughout the neighboring [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] sectors.<ref name="CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:9:08 Edition">{{InsiderCite|69|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:9:08 Edition}}</ref>

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] made use of the organization's sporadic reports on Separatist activity on his homeworld of [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|21.5 BBY]] in order to track down the activities of fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Depa Billaba/Legends|Depa Billaba]] who had been dispatched to the planet. Through intelligence's resources, Windu managed to uncover a report of a sabotage made against a Separatist starfighter base as well as the failure of the [[Balawai]] militia's attempts at eliminating Depa's resistance forces. At some point, Republic Intelligence received word that the Confederacy had pulled back its forces to the [[Gevarno Cluster/Legends|Gevarno Cluster]] and had left their base at [[Pelek Baw/Legends|Pelek Baw]] abandoned. Despite this being the case, there had been no sighting from Master Billaba which prompted concern from Master Windu. Later, an agent from the intelligence service reported to [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], Master Windu and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] that Master Billaba had gone renegade on Haruun Kal. When Palpatine decided to send a Republic Intelligence covert team to the planet to apprehend Depa Billaba, Mace Windu decided that he would attend the matter personally. After arriving on Haruun Kal, Master Windu was accompanied by a planetary chief from Republic Intelligence though she was later killed during the operation. Following the success of the mission on Haruun Kal, Master Mace Windu aided in enlisting [[Nick Rostu]] into Republic Intelligence.<ref name="S">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref>

===Final acts===
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] had captured the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[TC-16]] who had belonged to [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. After the successful capture of the [[Droid/Legends|droid]], it was transferred to the custody of Republic Intelligence on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for further debriefing. During the conflict with the Separatists, the agency was successful in deploying one of its agents on the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Escarte/Legends|Escarte]] where they proved to be vital in the capture of [[Thal K'sar]] as well as taking the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] to a secure facility. Following the discovery of the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian's]] [[Mechno-chair/Legends|mechanized chair]], it was learned that there had been a Sith Lord operating on Coruscant who was known as [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. This led to Republic Intelligence dispatching former [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] agent [[Dyne]] who worked alongside [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Valiant (clone trooper)|Valiant]] as well as the members of the Jedi Order in uncovering the identity of the mysterious Sith.<ref name="LE">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref>

At the closing stages of the Clone Wars, Obi-Wan Kenobi suggested to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] that they focus the efforts of Republic Intelligence on locating [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]]. On [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], Kenobi promised [[Tion Medon/Legends|Tion Medon]] that he would file a report with the intelligence service in regards to the crisis on the planet.<ref name="RotSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> By [[19 BBY/Legends|19.5 BBY]], [[Armand Isard/Legends|Armand Isard]] served as director of Republic Intelligence.<ref name="JT">''[[Jedi Trial]]''</ref> With the [[Declaration of a New Order]], Republic Intelligence became a part of the newly formed [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]].<ref name="LSatSoM" /> Some resources were also allocated to the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], the Empire's secret police.<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Shortly after that, [[Lorz Geptun]] was charged by the agency to gather more information on the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi Rebellion]] though he later uncovered truths about the decimation of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that his superiors did not want known and Geptun defected to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="LSatSoM" />
